## Checklist (must pass before merge)
- [ ] Build, typecheck, and lint succeed
- [ ] Unit tests pass (if any)
- [ ] Preview deploy renders (link or screenshot)
- [ ] For staging to main: performed quick smoke on staging.domana.app
- [ ] Docs or notes updated if behavior changes

## Summary
What changed and why? Link issues if applicable.

## Verification notes
Steps for reviewers to verify quickly.
